headline: Recommended approval of five sign applications and approved April 16 meeting minutes.
summary: The board reviewed sign applications for Everbowl, Cabot Dental, JM Gaddis Fine Home Building and Remodeling, Uncharted, and New Harmony Center for Health and Wellness, recommending approval of each by a 5-0 vote. The board also approved the April 16, 2026 meeting minutes as amended and moved two discussion items, on the Cummings Center Global Sign Variance and Sign Ordinance updates, to the June meeting.
decisions: Recommended approval of the wall and window signs for Everbowl, 19 Dodge Street, as presented. Motion carried 5-0.
Recommended approval of the freestanding sign for Cabot Dental, 332 Cabot Street, as presented. Motion carried 5-0.
Recommended approval of the wall sign for JM Gaddis Fine Home Building and Remodeling, 94 Corning St, with the findings as determined. Motion carried 5-0.
Recommended approval of the wall sign and any future panel sign changes to the freestanding sign for Uncharted, 65 Dodge Street, as presented. Motion carried 5-0.
Recommended approval of the signage for New Harmony Center for Health and Wellness, 7 Thorndike Street, with the findings as determined. Motion carried 5-0.
Approved the April 16, 2026 meeting minutes as amended. Motion carried 5-0.
Moved the discussion of The Cummings Center Global Sign Variance to the June meeting. Motion carried 5-0.
Moved the discussion of Sign Ordinance updates to the June meeting. Motion carried 5-0.

James Gaddis, applicant, explained that the existing sign could remain on the property, with 46

 60

Board finds that this property is located in the R10 District, the most common residential zone in 62 
the City. There is another existing business located across the street from this property. This 63 
neighborhood should be considered mixed use.  64 
 65 
B) The economic and business interest of the party having erected or proposing to erect the sign. 66 
The Board finds that the applicant owns a business, and it is necessary to have a sign for the 67 
business to exist and do well. The proposed sign has parallels to the previous, existing sign on 68 
the property. 69
